mapper.select:
select SUM(a.fcdMoney) as fcdMoneySum, SUM(a.faDemand) as faDemandSum, sum(a.payAmt) as payApplySum from ( select (select sum(p.Pay_Apply) from Con_Pay p where p.P_Id=mn.P_Id and p.Pay_State=7) as payAmt, (select SUM(fcd.Fcd_Money) from Fund_Collection_Details fcd where fcd.P_Id=mn.P_Id and fcd.State=7) as fcdMoney, (select SUM(fa.Fa_Demand) from Fund_Appropriation fa where fa.P_Id=mn.P_Id and fa.State=7) as faDemand from Pre_Project mn left join SYS_Department dp on dp.D_Id = mn.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.P_Construction_Unit
) a

select
fa.Fa_Code as faCode, pro.P_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget, mn.* from Fund_Collection_Details mn
left join Fund_Appropriation fa on fa.id = mn.Fa_Id
order by mn.${params.sortFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by mn.Create_Time DESC

select fa.Fa_Code as faCode, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Build_Model as pBuildModel, pro.P_Inv_Total as pInvTotal, pro.P_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget, pro.P_Use_Unit as pUseUnit, dp.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, mn.* from Fund_Collection_Details mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Fund_Appropriation fa on fa.id = mn.Fa_Id left join SYS_Department dp on dp.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit where mn.id = #{id}

select fa.Fa_Code as faCode, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Build_Model as pBuildModel, pro.P_Inv_Total as pInvTotal, pro.P_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget, pro.P_Use_Unit as pUseUnit, dp.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, mn.* from Fund_Collection_Details mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Fund_Appropriation fa on fa.id = mn.Fa_Id left join SYS_Department dp on dp.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit where mn.P_Id = #{pId} and mn.State = 7 order by mn.Create_Time desc limit 1
